_metadata.description: Shadow-safe improvement: baseline engagement lifecycle, shadow environment routing, self-scenario guard, and measurement isolation (OT-P0-006).

requirements.title: Engagement lifecycle: start, promote, abandon
requirements.description: When a profile enables baseline promote, the first agent run opens a git-control-tower engagement (--mode auto); objective-met terminates with promote, other halts abandon, and checkpoint_on_green promotes early at cadence boundaries.

requirements.title: Shadow environment routing to agent runs
requirements.description: Agent executions for an engaged task receive VROOLI_SHADOW_SCENARIOS (ambient env unioned with the engaged scenario) so nested CLI calls route to the shadow instance; live-mode engagements add no routing.

requirements.title: Self-scenario engagements are externalized
requirements.description: Ecosystem-manager never opens a baseline engagement on itself (self-deadlock guard); improving EM is handled externally.

requirements.title: Profile block validates and defaults OFF
requirements.description: The baseline_promote profile block (enabled, mode, cadence_iter) validates its mode enum, defaults to end_of_engagement, and the feature is fully inert when absent or disabled.

requirements.title: Measurement isolation: audits run against the shadow
requirements.description: When a task is in a shadow engagement, the controller's MEASURE step (test-genie audit) must route to the shadow instance — shadow-resolved scenario target and VROOLI_SHADOW_SCENARIOS on the audit subprocess — so termination and promote decisions reflect the shadow state, never the live instance. Known gap: findings/runner.go currently audits the live scenario.

validation.notes: To be written with the fix (test under api/pkg/findings/): assert the audit subprocess receives the shadow scenario target and shadow env when an engagement is active, then convert this entry to type=test.

requirements.title: Engagement cleanup on profile change/reset
requirements.description: When InitializeAutoSteer resets execution state (profile swap) or a task is cancelled mid-engagement, any open engagement is closed (abandoned) rather than left dangling.

validation.notes: To be written with the fix (test in api/pkg/queue/autosteer_integration_test.go): profile reset path closes any open engagement, then convert this entry to type=test.
